# `aube runtime`

- **Usage:** `aube runtime <SUBCOMMAND>`
- **Aliases:** `rt`
- **Effect:** read-only

Manage the project's Node.js runtime (pin, install, inspect)

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube runtime list
aube runtime set node 24 --save-exact
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-runtime) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->
